column1: # Example: oxidative phosphorylation and electron transport chain proteins of Mycobacterium tuberculosis mc2-6020 (a lysA panCD double auxotroph derived from H37Rv) measured by proteomics after carbon starvation (CS) versus replicating (Rep) culture, grouped by complex as in the paper.

# Source: Devlin KL, Leach DT, Stratton KG, Lamichhane G, Lin VS, Beatty KE. (2025) Proteomic characterization of Mycobacterium tuberculosis subjected to carbon starvation. mSystems 10(5):e0153024. https://doi.org/10.1128/msystems.01530-24

# Table S3 (msystems.01530-24-s0003.xlsx), sheet "OxPhos", the protein set of Fig. 3A: all 40 listed proteins are kept, with the complex headings of the sheet as the group column. Values are the paper's log2 fold change (CS versus Rep) and its P value (ANOVA, or G-test for proteins found in only one group); an empty value means the protein was not quantified, as in the paper. Licensed CC BY 4.0; values as published.

# Columns: protein = gene symbol in the LIVIA Atlas index, mapped from the table's locus ID or accession (unmapped rows keep the locus ID); uniprot = index accession; locus_in_table / accession_in_table / name_in_table as given; complex = the sheet's heading above the row.
